family: GTK2 public preview scrollbar stepper event path

procedure.raw_event_observer: XI2 RawButtonPress/RawButtonRelease on Xephyr root; observes events without selecting core button events
procedure.public_route: Original public preview backend -> preview_gtk2.py with verified --rc; one horizontal-left stepper only

public_target_run.test_exit: Assertion held_differences > 0 failed; runner then closed its own preview and backend child

observer_control_same_display.target: Xephyr root with no GTK preview mapped
observer_control_same_display.purpose: confirms observer sees press and release from separate xdotool invocations in this Xephyr

observations.recipe_path: Existing R11 source audit: the public command passes --rc; NativeSession validates its receipt and calls Gtk.rc_parse. recipe_applied=false means incomplete GTK2 coverage, not omitted RC; neither fact proves pixel effect.

interpretation: The public-target run reached the X server as a raw button press, but no release or native adjustment was recorded and the stepper pixels did not change. The same observer saw both events in the empty-root control. This narrows the discrepancy to the target-window test path but does not localize cause among xdotool target delivery, pointer/grab behavior, or GTK2 scene routing. No causal claim is made. R13 later showed pointer child=0 at mapped preview coordinates; therefore the R12 raw press does not establish that the pointer was over the GTK2 window, and its target attribution remains unverified.
limitations: One target only; no full matrix.
Raw events are server-level and do not prove delivery to a specific GDK widget.
No new MAME input or guest action.
No product code or palette changed.
conclusion: R12 adds a discriminating event-path observation but does not pass I167. Do not repeat the same click matrix. The next diagnostic must log client/GDK delivery or use another independently authorized Fila Atual item. Historical SR10.4 comparison remains outstanding. Later R13 hit-test evidence weakens target attribution: the raw press is real server evidence, but the intended GTK2 window was not confirmed under the pointer.
